title: OpenRTB 2.6 Regs
description: Contains any legal, governmental, or industry regulations that the sender deems applicable to the request.

coppa.description: Flag indicating if this request is subject to the COPPA regulations established by the USA FTC.

gdpr.description: Flag that indicates whether or not the request is subject to GDPR regulations. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

us_privacy.description: Communicates signals regarding consumer privacy under US privacy regulation.

gpp.description: Contains the Global Privacy Platform's consent string.

gpp_sid.description: Array of the section(s) of the GPP string which should be applied for this transaction.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
